Rory.style: Say this like a friendly, upbeat castaway who is glad to see a new face, casual and warm:

Raleigh.style: Say this like a cheerful, quick-witted castaway who enjoys giving hints, bright and encouraging:

rory_intro.speaker: Rory
rory_intro.text: Hey, you made it! We washed up here too. See that bunker? Site B. There are matches inside, but the door's out of power. It needs four power cells. I've spotted three of them lying around outside, close by. Find them, and we can get that door open.

rory_progress.speaker: Rory
rory_progress.text: Nice, you've found some! The rest are close. Try looking around the outside of the buildings.

rory_three.speaker: Rory
rory_three.text: Three cells! One more to go. Go and talk to Raleigh. I think she knows where the last one is.

rory_four.speaker: Rory
rory_four.text: That's all four! Head over to the Site B door. It should open for you now.

rory_door_open.speaker: Rory
rory_door_open.text: The door's open! The matches should be somewhere inside.

rory_matches.speaker: Rory
rory_matches.text: You've got the matches! Now get that campfire going before it gets dark.

rory_fire.speaker: Rory
rory_fire.text: Now that's a campfire! Thanks, friend. Nobody's freezing tonight.

raleigh_intro.speaker: Raleigh
raleigh_intro.text: Hi there! Looking for power cells? The carnival booth gives one away as a prize. Stand on the yellow mat out front and knock the target down with coconuts.

raleigh_won.speaker: Raleigh
raleigh_won.text: Great throw! That cell's all yours. Grab it off the stand inside the booth.

raleigh_four.speaker: Raleigh
raleigh_four.text: You've got the prize! Now try the Site B door.

raleigh_door_open.speaker: Raleigh
raleigh_door_open.text: The door's open? Go and grab those matches!

raleigh_fire.speaker: Raleigh
raleigh_fire.text: You did it! Look at that fire. Now that deserves some music.
